description: Movement rules: how squads march, crowd, pass allies and regroup (battle-sim.md §10). closeInRange: in a squad standing in melee, men not yet fighting step toward the nearest enemy within this (m, edge to edge) until they reach him; 0 = only those who touch fight (asked for 2026-11-23). withdrawClearance: a squad stepping back out of melee faces the enemy until none is within reach + this (decided 2026-11-22). Distances in metres, times in seconds (whole ticks of 0.05 s), angles in degrees. Fighter sizes and speeds are in fighters.json; formation spacing, hold weight and ally squeeze speed in formations.json.
